caption: A special episode featuring the most Ghibli-esque cafes 🍃 Thank you to @tomogo.official for taking me on a cafe tour and showing me these cute spots!!  Cafes mentioned: ☕️ Coffee Hall Kugutsuso 🌱 Tea House Happa And for those planning on coming to Japan anytime soon, TOMOGO! is a start-up tour company focused on highlighting lesser-known areas, local communities, and businesses.
